title: Pakistan Just Picked Iran's Side
fullVoiceover: Pakistan just made the choice that breaks the Quad. Here's why this matters more than you think. Pakistan opened six overland routes through Balochistan to keep Iran's economy moving — bypassing the blockaded Strait of Hormuz entirely. Three thousand containers stuck at Karachi just got rerouted. Pakistan's military is securing the Gwadar-to-Gabd corridor. Three superpowers just chose sides on a war India can't ignore. China and Pakistan are with Iran. The US is alone with Israel. And India? India is the only major economy buying from both sides. New Delhi just became the most important phone call in geopolitics. Modi can pressure Tehran. Modi can pressure Washington. Modi can do nothing — and still extract concessions from either side. Pakistan picked Iran. India picked everyone. So what does Washington do now?

qualityGate.topicCoherence: must reference Pakistan/Iran/India/China/Modi/Tehran/Washington - no off-topic hallucinations (NO astronomy, NO unrelated tech)
factualClaims: Pakistan opened six overland transit routes to move shipments into Iran via Balochistan crossings at Gabd and Taftan, activating 2008 bilateral road agreement (verified May 2026 OilPrice/Reuters reporting)
Three thousand-plus containers stranded at Karachi and Port Qasim are now being rerouted overland (verified)
Strait of Hormuz vessel traffic at ~5% of pre-conflict levels (verified Oxford Economics + House of Commons Library)
Pakistan-China-Iran tilt: well-documented, China secures Gwadar port concession
India hedging: continues Russian crude at discount + has not joined Western sanctions on Iran (long-documented)
qualityGate.noHallucinations: Must NOT reference Alpha Centauri, NASA discoveries, unrelated tech. Removed unverified 'yuan transit fee' claim and unverified 'Iran's pipeline route' framing. Direction of trade: shipments move INTO Iran via Pakistan ports (not Iranian oil shipping out through Pakistan).
